business_problem: Debdoot Mukherjee, Head of AI and Demand Engineering, Meesho, says, "We were looking for a generative AI solution primarily to turbocharge our customer service function.
solution_summary: Meesho built its Microsoft solution to improve customer-service and conversational-support workflows. Debdoot Mukherjee, Head of AI and Demand Engineering, Meesho, says, "We were looking for a generative AI solution primarily to turbocharge our customer service function. Key components included GitHub Copilot delivered dashboards, apps, or copilots to users, and Azure OpenAI Service ran model inference or heavy processing. User prompts and domain content are orchestrated through GitHub Copilot, processed by Azure OpenAI Service, and then delivered through GitHub Copilot so Meesho can return context-aware answers or automation in the flow of work. The stack stayed governed and extensible on Microsoft. Recognizing the transformative potential of generative AI, Meesho's leadership team saw it as a catalyst for improved productivity across diverse business functions.
